supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity during the review window matches the inventoried RouteWise update-check pattern: routewiseupd.exe on WS-KNGUYEN-01 connected through the proxy to update.routewise.com at approximately five-minute intervals from 13:36:51 through 14:06:50 UTC.
The updater process was observed at the inventoried RouteWise path, and Sysmon records it initiating connections to the explicit proxy at times corresponding to the RouteWise proxy entries.

The proxy records identify the alerted HTTPS destination as update.routewise.com and show successful CONNECT requests; the evidence does not show the updater connecting to a different external destination.

known_telemetry_limitations: The updater's proxy records are CONNECT tunnel entries; they do not expose the HTTPS request paths, response contents, or downloaded payload.
The available records do not establish the updater executable's signature, hash, or file integrity.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the contents or safety of any data exchanged inside the updater's HTTPS tunnels.
The evidence does not establish whether the RouteWise executable on disk is authentic and unmodified.
unrelated_findings: Separate investigation recommended: paul.becker credentials were requested from WS-KNGUYEN-01's source IP (10.52.10.22), and WS-PBECKER-01 recorded network logons for paul.becker from that same source. This is inconsistent with the inventory practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-PBECKER-01; it is not evidence that the alerted RouteWise connections are malicious. Records: T106-00091, T106-00092, T106-00094, T106-00109, T106-00110, T106-00112.
